description: Six phase-locked LFOs whose rates modulate each other, so a clocked set of waves drifts in and out of step by an adjustable amount

params.text: Attenuverts the rate CV before it is added to the rate knob
Multiplies the clock rate when set to 1 or above, and divides it when set to -1 or below, over a travel of -24 to 24
Attenuverts the wonk CV before it is added to the wonk knob
Sets how far the waves pull each other's rates about, from locked at zero to the full amount at one
Picks which of the six waves modulates the rate of each one, counted round the ring from 1 to 6
Attenuverts the nodes CV before it is added to the nodes knob
Spreads the six phases around the cycle, -3 to 3, through three-way and two-way groupings in each direction
Attenuverts the modulation depth CV before it is added to the depth knob
Sets the peak voltage of every output, 0 to 5V
Snaps all six phases back to their nodes on each press

inputs.text: Sets the base rate from the time between two rises; it also reads three special levels used by the CV funk chaining scheme, at 10.42V, 10.69V and 10.86V
Changes the rate multiplier, added to the rate knob through its attenuverter
Changes how far the waves pull each other's rates about, scaled by a tenth and added to the wonk knob through its attenuverter, the total clamped to 0 to 1
Moves the phase spread, added to the nodes knob through its attenuverter
Changes the peak output voltage, halved and added to the depth knob through its attenuverter, the total clamped to -5 to 5V
A rise snaps all six phases back to their nodes

outputs.text: One of the six waves, swinging either side of 0V as far as the depth setting, or from 0V to twice that in unipolar mode
Carries all six waves at once as six polyphonic channels

notes: with no clock patched the module falls back to a two-second cycle, so the waves run at a quarter of a hertz until a clock sets the rate
menu: Unipolar mode (0-10V) — lifts every output so that it swings from 0V upward instead of either side of 0V, reaching 10V at the full depth setting
